<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Confront merges and commits with the project's branch flow (`branch_flow:`).

```text
Confronts the branch flow anchors.yaml declares:

  branch_flow:
    merges:
      review:     [develop, "hotfix/*"]
      production: [review, "hotfix/*"]
    protected: [review, production]

  anchors branch check --head develop --base review   a pull request's pair
  anchors branch check --push --ref production --sha <sha>
                                                        a push: the merged pull request that made it
  anchors branch guard                                   the hooks: no commit on a protected branch

In a CI, check reads its sides from the environment: GITHUB_EVENT_NAME, GITHUB_HEAD_REF and
GITHUB_BASE_REF for a pull request, GITHUB_REF_NAME and GITHUB_SHA for a push. A push asks
GitHub, with the gh CLI (GH_TOKEN), for the merged pull request whose merge commit is the
sha.
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors branch
```

## Subcomandos

### `anchors branch check`

Refuse a pull request, or a push, the branch flow does not allow.

#### Uso

```bash
anchors branch check [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base` |  | the pull request's base branch (default $GITHUB_BASE_REF) |
| `--head` |  | the pull request's head branch (default $GITHUB_HEAD_REF) |
| `--push` |  | confront a push instead of a pull request (default when $GITHUB_EVENT_NAME is push) |
| `--ref` |  | the pushed branch (default $GITHUB_REF_NAME) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--sha` |  | the pushed commit (default $GITHUB_SHA) |

### `anchors branch guard`

Refuse a commit on a branch the flow protects (the pre-commit and pre-merge-commit hooks).

#### Uso

```bash
anchors branch guard [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

## Changelog e pull requests — família

Comandos da mesma família — o que distingue cada um:

| Comando | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors changelog`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/changelog/) | Build the technical changelog from the commits, release by release |
| [`anchors commit-msg`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/commit-msg/) | Confront the commit message with the format the changelog will read |
| [`anchors pr-body`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/pr-body/) | Write the lines linking this work's cards, in the platform's syntax |
| [`anchors backfill-labels`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/backfill-labels/) | Write into open issues the links the new version began to mark |
| [`anchors report`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/report/) | Generate reports in docs/ by perspective (cuts of what Anchors measures) |
| **`anchors branch`** | Confront merges and commits with the project's branch flow (`branch_flow:`) |
